mentions.name: Next-generation post-RSS newsreader
mentions.description: A next-generation newsreader intended to succeed RSS-style news consumption; the idea has stalled because news is currently depressing and most people prefer to avoid it.
mentions.problem: News is so depressing these days that most of the world wants to ostrich and avoid it, which undercuts demand for a newsreader.
mentions.source_excerpt: - a next-generation post-RSS newsreader. But news is so depressing these days. I think most of the world wants to ostrich and I don't blame them.
